board: Official Compute Module 5 IO Board, logical development profile

vref.selector: R5 for 3.3V, R4 for 1.8V, exactly one resistor fitted
vref.effect: metadata only; no signal-level or voltage enforcement

pinmux.spi0_route: fixed, bypasses the unimplemented RP1 pinmux registers

40-pin SPI0.implementation: RP1 DW SPI0, programmed I/O; test slave explicitly attached

40-pin UART0.implementation: generic separate PL011 substitute, serial1; no RP1 UART0 register emulation

40-pin GPIO.implementation: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no gpiochip or RP1 pinmux driver
40-pin GPIO.gpios: 0..27; alternate functions conflict physically; model does not enforce mux

RJ45.routing: CM5 Ethernet PHY to CM5IO magjack; PoE through optional HAT via J9

USB Type-C J11.implementation: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no USB recovery or power delivery model

M.2 M-key.routing: BCM2712 PCIe1, Gen2 x1 by default
M.2 M-key.implementation: independent GPEX substitute, cm5-expansion bus; no link timing/lane training

RTC battery.implementation: PL031 software-test substitute; firmware/PMIC RTC NOT_IMPLEMENTED

eMMC.routing: CM5 on-module 8-bit SDIO1, not a carrier SD card
eMMC.implementation: BCM2712 SDHCI/eMMC NOT_IMPLEMENTED; VirtIO substitute on expansion bus

J2.implementation: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; direct kernel boot ignores physical boot overrides
